cohort: 9558 pregnant women (7613 without GDM and 1945 with GDM) who gave birth at the Women's Hospital, School of Medicine, Zhejiang University between January 1, 2019 and December 31, 2019.
finding: Pregnant women with GDM had a higher percentage and absolute count of immature granulocytes and were more likely to experience preterm birth, macrosomia, and cesarean section.
